name: relocate
summary: Relocate a replica beneath another instance

name: relocate-replicas
summary: Relocates all or part of the replicas of a given instance under another instance

name: take-siblings
summary: Turn all siblings of a replica into its sub-replicas.

name: regroup-replicas
summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replicas and make it local master of its siblings

name: move-up
summary: Move a replica one level up the topology

name: move-up-replicas
summary: Moves replicas of the given instance one level up the topology

name: move-below
summary: Moves a replica beneath its sibling. Both replicas must be actively replicating from same master.

name: move-equivalent
summary: Moves a replica beneath another server, based on previously recorded "equivalence coordinates"

name: repoint
summary: Make the given instance replicate from another instance without changing the binglog coordinates. Use with care

name: repoint-replicas
summary: Repoint all replicas of given instance to replicate back from the instance. Use with care

name: take-master
summary: Turn an instance into a master of its own master; essentially switch the two.

name: make-co-master
summary: Create a master-master replication. Given instance is a replica which replicates directly from a master.

name: get-candidate-replica
summary: Information command suggesting the most up-to-date replica of a given instance that is good for promotion

name: regroup-replicas-bls
summary: Regroup Binlog Server replicas of a given instance

name: move-gtid
summary: Move a replica beneath another instance.

name: move-replicas-gtid
summary: Moves all replicas of a given instance under another (destination) instance using GTID

name: regroup-replicas-gtid
summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replica and make it local master of its siblings, using GTID.

name: match
summary: Matches a replica beneath another (destination) instance using Pseudo-GTID

name: match-up
summary: Transport the replica one level up the hierarchy, making it child of its grandparent, using Pseudo-GTID

name: rematch
summary: Reconnect a replica onto its master, via PSeudo-GTID.

name: match-replicas
summary: Matches all replicas of a given instance under another (destination) instance using Pseudo-GTID

name: match-up-replicas
summary: Matches replicas of the given instance one level up the topology, making them siblings of given instance, using Pseudo-GTID

name: regroup-replicas-pgtid
summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replica and make it local master of its siblings, using Pseudo-GTID.

name: enable-gtid
summary: If possible, turn on GTID replication

name: disable-gtid
summary: Turn off GTID replication, back to file:pos replication

name: which-gtid-errant
summary: Get errant GTID set (empty results if no errant GTID)

name: gtid-errant-reset-master
summary: Reset master on instance, remove GTID errant transactions

name: skip-query
summary: Skip a single statement on a replica; either when running with GTID or without

name: stop-replica
summary: Issue a STOP SLAVE on an instance

name: start-replica
summary: Issue a START SLAVE on an instance

name: restart-replica
summary: STOP and START SLAVE on an instance

name: reset-replica
summary: Issues a RESET SLAVE command; use with care

name: change-master-credentials
summary: Re-apply replication user/password (and SSL material, if ReplicationCredentialsQuery provides it) on an instance while preserving its existing SOURCE_SSL/TLS configuration.

name: detach-replica-master-host
summary: Stops replication and modifies Master_Host into an impossible, yet reversible, value.

name: reattach-replica-master-host
summary: Undo a detach-replica-master-host operation

name: master-pos-wait
summary: Wait until replica reaches given replication coordinates (--binlog=file:pos)

name: enable-semi-sync-master
summary: Enable semi-sync replication (master-side)

name: disable-semi-sync-master
summary: Disable semi-sync replication (master-side)

name: enable-semi-sync-replica
summary: Enable semi-sync replication (replica-side)

name: disable-semi-sync-replica
summary: Disable semi-sync replication (replica-side)

name: restart-replica-statements
summary: Get a list of statements to execute to stop then restore replica to same execution state. Provide --statement for injected statement

name: can-replicate-from
summary: Can an instance (-i) replicate from another (-d) according to replication rules? Prints 'true|false'

name: is-replicating
summary: Is an instance (-i) actively replicating right now

name: is-replication-stopped
summary: Is an instance (-i) a replica with both replication threads stopped

name: set-read-only
summary: Turn an instance read-only, via SET GLOBAL read_only := 1

name: set-writeable
summary: Turn an instance writeable, via SET GLOBAL read_only := 0

name: flush-binary-logs
summary: Flush binary logs on an instance

name: purge-binary-logs
summary: Purge binary logs of an instance

name: last-pseudo-gtid
summary: Find latest Pseudo-GTID entry in instance's binary logs

name: locate-gtid-errant
summary: List binary logs containing errant GTIDs

name: last-executed-relay-entry
summary: Find coordinates of last executed relay log entry

name: correlate-relaylog-pos
summary: Given an instance (-i) and relaylog coordinates (--binlog=file:pos), find the correlated coordinates in another instance's relay logs (-d)

name: find-binlog-entry
summary: Get binlog file:pos of entry given by --pattern (exact full match, not a regular expression) in a given instance

name: correlate-binlog-pos
summary: Given an instance (-i) and binlog coordinates (--binlog=file:pos), find the correlated coordinates in another instance (-d)

name: submit-pool-instances
summary: Submit a pool name with a list of instances in that pool

name: cluster-pool-instances
summary: List all pools and their associated instances

name: which-heuristic-cluster-pool-instances
summary: List instances of a given cluster which are in either any pool or in a specific pool

name: find
summary: Find instances whose hostname matches given regex pattern

name: search
summary: Search instances by name, version, version comment, port

name: clusters
summary: List all clusters known to orchestrator

name: clusters-alias
summary: List all clusters known to orchestrator

name: all-clusters-masters
summary: List of writeable masters, one per cluster

name: topology
summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology, given a member of that topology

name: topology-tabulated
summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology, given a member of that topology

name: topology-tags
summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology and instance tags, given a member of that topology

name: all-instances
summary: The complete list of known instances

name: which-instance
summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port representation of the given instance, or error if unknown

name: which-cluster
summary: Output the name of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

name: which-cluster-alias
summary: Output the alias of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

name: which-cluster-domain
summary: Output the domain name of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

name: which-heuristic-domain-instance
summary: Returns the instance associated as the cluster's writer with a cluster's domain name.

name: which-cluster-master
summary: Output the name of the master in a given cluster

name: which-cluster-instances
summary: Output the list of instances participating in same cluster as given instance

name: which-cluster-osc-replicas
summary: Output a list of replicas in a cluster, that could serve as a pt-online-schema-change operation control replicas

name: which-cluster-gh-ost-replicas
summary: Output a list of replicas in a cluster, that could serve as a gh-ost working server

name: which-master
summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port representation of a given instance's master

name: which-downtimed-instances
summary: List instances currently downtimed, potentially filtered by cluster

name: which-replicas
summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port list of replicas of a given instance

name: which-lost-in-recovery
summary: List instances marked as downtimed for being lost in a recovery process

name: instance-status
summary: Output short status on a given instance

name: get-cluster-heuristic-lag
summary: For a given cluster (indicated by an instance or alias), output a heuristic "representative" lag of that cluster

name: submit-masters-to-kv-stores
summary: Submit master of a specific cluster, or all masters of all clusters to key-value stores

name: tags
summary: List tags for a given instance

name: tag-value
summary: Get tag value for a specific instance

name: tagged
summary: List instances tagged by tag-string. Format: "tagname" or "tagname=tagvalue" or comma separated "tag0,tag1=val1,tag2" for intersection of all.

name: tag
summary: Add a tag to a given instance. Tag in "tagname" or "tagname=tagvalue" format

name: untag
summary: Remove a tag from an instance

name: untag-all
summary: Remove a tag from all matching instances

name: discover
summary: Lookup an instance, investigate it

name: forget
summary: Forget about an instance's existence

name: begin-maintenance
summary: Request a maintenance lock on an instance

name: end-maintenance
summary: Remove maintenance lock from an instance

name: in-maintenance
summary: Check whether instance is under maintenance

name: begin-downtime
summary: Mark an instance as downtimed

name: end-downtime
summary: Indicate an instance is no longer downtimed

name: recover
summary: Do auto-recovery given a dead instance

name: recover-lite
summary: Do auto-recovery given a dead instance. Orchestrator chooses the best course of actionwithout executing external processes

name: force-master-failover
summary: Forcibly discard master and initiate a failover, even if orchestrator doesn't see a problem. This command lets orchestrator choose the replacement master

name: force-master-takeover
summary: Forcibly discard master and promote another (direct child) instance instead, even if everything is running well

name: graceful-master-takeover
summary: Gracefully promote a new master. Either indicate identity of new master via '-d designated.instance.com' or setup replication tree to have a single direct replica to the master.

name: graceful-master-takeover-auto
summary: Gracefully promote a new master. orchestrator will attempt to pick the promoted replica automatically

name: replication-analysis
summary: Request an analysis of potential crash incidents in all known topologies

name: ack-all-recoveries
summary: Acknowledge all recoveries; this unblocks pending future recoveries

name: ack-cluster-recoveries
summary: Acknowledge recoveries for a given cluster; this unblocks pending future recoveries

name: ack-instance-recoveries
summary: Acknowledge recoveries for a given instance; this unblocks pending future recoveries

name: register-candidate
summary: Indicate that a specific instance is a preferred candidate for master promotion

name: register-hostname-unresolve
summary: Assigns the given instance a virtual (aka "unresolved") name

name: deregister-hostname-unresolve
summary: Explicitly deregister/dosassociate a hostname with an "unresolved" name

name: set-heuristic-domain-instance
summary: Associate domain name of given cluster with what seems to be the writer master for that cluster

name: snapshot-topologies
summary: Take a snapshot of existing topologies.

name: active-nodes
summary: List currently active orchestrator nodes

name: resolve
summary: Resolve given hostname

name: reset-hostname-resolve-cache
summary: Clear the hostname resolve cache

name: show-resolve-hosts
summary: Show the content of the hostname_resolve table. Generally used for debugging

name: show-unresolve-hosts
summary: Show the content of the hostname_unresolve table. Generally used for debugging

name: custom-command
summary: Execute a custom command on the agent as defined in the agent conf

name: disable-global-recoveries
summary: Disallow orchestrator from performing recoveries globally

name: enable-global-recoveries
summary: Allow orchestrator to perform recoveries globally

name: check-global-recoveries
summary: Show the global recovery configuration

name: bulk-instances
summary: Return a list of sorted instance names known to orchestrator

name: bulk-promotion-rules
summary: Return a list of promotion rules known to orchestrator

name: async-discover
summary: async-discover

name: forget-cluster
summary: forget-cluster

name: can-replicate-from-gtid
summary: can-replicate-from-gtid

name: stop-replica-nice
summary: stop-replica-nice

name: delay-replication
summary: delay-replication

name: which-broken-replicas
summary: which-broken-replicas

name: which-cluster-osc-running-replicas
summary: which-cluster-osc-running-replicas

name: dominant-dc
summary: dominant-dc

summary: raft-health

summary: raft-leader-hostname

summary: raft-configuration

summary: raft-bootstrap

summary: raft-add-member

name: raft-remove-member
summary: raft-remove-member

name: raft-transfer-leadership
summary: raft-transfer-leadership

summary: raft-snapshot

summary: Apply errant GTID as empty transactions on the cluster master
